name: salesforce

values.default: Send Salesforce CRM events into Extole FlowBuilder
Trigger referral and loyalty flows from Salesforce Opportunity, Lead, Contact, and Account events.

notes: The businessEvents MULTI_SOCKET must be added after creation via POST /v1/components/{id}/settings.
journeyName is intentionally excluded — that is a campaign-level concern, not the integration's.
Business events are created in the same campaign_id as the integration component.
